create.name: Dawn Mauricio
create.bio:
Dawn Mauricio is an insight meditation teacher in Montréal who draws on the Theravada Buddhist tradition, with a strong thread of body-based practice running through her work. A second-generation Filipina-Canadian, she began teaching yoga and mindfulness in 2005 and spent over a decade doing so full time before turning mainly to Dhamma teaching. Her training came through True North Insight's first teacher development group and several programmes at Spirit Rock in California, including its four-year retreat teacher training, which she completed in 2021. She has since added training as a Somatic Experiencing practitioner.

Much of her teaching now happens on silent residential retreats in California, alongside online series and occasional in-person classes in Montréal. Since 2020 she has run the Everyday Dhamma Community, an online membership with daily guided sittings, weekly talks, monthly gatherings and a mentoring tier for people who teach. Her style is warm and lightly humorous, mixing traditional teachings with stories from her own life and a clear interest in belonging and collective freedom. She wrote Mindfulness Meditation for Beginners (2020), a book of fifty short practices, and her guided meditations can be found on Insight Timer and in the Happier app. She teaches in English.

books.title: Mindfulness Meditation for Beginners: 50 Meditations to Practice Awareness, Acceptance, and Peace
books.author: Dawn Mauricio
books.description: Her introductory book, published in 2020, explains what mindfulness is and then offers fifty brief practices of five to fifteen minutes each. It is written for people starting out who want to build a steady daily habit.

courses.title: Everyday Dhamma Community
courses.description: An online membership she has led since 2020, with daily guided sittings and weekly Dhamma talks, a monthly meetup and personal check-ins. Higher tiers add monthly workshops and one-to-one mentoring for those who teach meditation.

courses.title: Retreats, Classes and Online Series with Dawn Mauricio
courses.description: Her calendar of teaching: week-long silent insight retreats in California with other senior teachers, multi-week online courses, and introductory classes in Montréal. Prices vary by event and host.

free_resources.title: Mindfulness Of Breath
free_resources.description: Her most popular guided track on Insight Timer: a simple sitting that rests attention on the breath. Free to play in the app or online.

free_resources.title: Setting An Intention
free_resources.description: A short guided practice for choosing what you want to bring into the day or a sitting. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Dawn Mauricio's Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: An archive of more than fifty of her recorded talks and practice instructions from retreats and daylongs, on themes such as kindness, compassion, energy and the Four Noble Truths. Free to stream.
